title: Badki Bhabhi
desc: Kailash Purohit lives in a joint family. Soon, he proposes to break down their house, in order to forge unity amongst his brothers.

title: Kaun Apna Kaun Paraya
desc: Two people develop feelings for each other, but face various challenges in their relationship due to their differing family backgrounds.

title: Devra Pe Manva Dole
desc: Sagar and Pooja love each other. However, things get complicated when Sagar disappears and his sister-in-law, Aarti, passes away following childbirth.

title: Dulhan Wahi Jo Piya Man Bhaye
desc: Raja falls in love with Diya in London and returns home to seek his father's approval. However, in a tragic twist, his dying father asks him to marry Tulsi.

title: Aashiq Awara
desc: A thief is always on the run from the law enforcement officers. Soon, he falls in love with a woman, whose father caused his parents' death.

title: Sangram
desc: The differences between two brothers increase due to their upbringing. While one brother decides to become a criminal and join a local political party, the other follows the path of righteousness.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
